why: Jhin needs to root a target with Deadly Flourish and open Curtain Call, but Arcane Shift lets Ezreal leave both the root line and the ult cone after they start. Mystic Shot also pokes from outside Jhin's range between his slow shots, and Ezreal hits hardest while Jhin is stuck reloading. Ezreal won 19 of 29 pro games (65.5%) by never standing still for Jhin's set-up.
tips: Save Arcane Shift for Deadly Flourish or Curtain Call instead of using it to jump forward for poke.
Poke with Mystic Shot while Jhin has fired his fourth shot and is reloading.
Step behind minions before trading so Jhin's grenade bounces and Flourish cannot reach you cleanly.

why: Lucian wants short dash-in bursts before his cooldowns run out, but Yunara builds Unleash stacks on the wave and then out-trades him once Cultivation of Spirit is active with bonus attack speed and splash hits. Her Arc of Judgment slow also stops Lucian chasing after his first dash. Yunara won 14 of 25 pro games (56.0%) in this older-meta pairing by surviving the first burst and winning the longer exchange.
tips: Build Unleash stacks on minions first and only trade once Cultivation of Spirit is ready to activate.
Use Arc of Judgment as Lucian dashes in so the slow cuts his follow-up damage short.
Hold Transcend One's Self for an all-in or teamfight, not for farming a single wave.

why: Ezreal needs Mystic Shot poke to chip his lane down, but Spell Shield blocks a key Mystic Shot or Essence Flux and refunds the trade, while Ricochet and Boomerang Blade clear the wave faster than Ezreal can push. Once Sivir owns the push, Ezreal must farm under tower and cannot set up poke angles. Sivir won 16 of 21 pro games (76.2%) by deleting the wave and shielding the poke that matters.
tips: Save Spell Shield for Essence Flux or a Mystic Shot aimed at you, not for poke hitting the wave.
Push with Ricochet every wave so Ezreal must spend Mystic Shots on minions instead of you.
Use On the Hunt to reach fights first after crashing a wave, rather than chasing Ezreal in lane.

why: Caitlyn wants to trap Ezreal under tower and poke him at max range, but Arcane Shift steps out of Yordle Snap Trap lines and over Piltover Peacemaker trades. Ezreal also farms safely with Mystic Shot when Caitlyn freezes, so her range never turns into a health lead she can dive on. Ezreal won 13 of 21 pro games (61.9%) by refusing Caitlyn's trap game and scaling into mid-game poke.
tips: Farm with Mystic Shot from max range when Caitlyn freezes the wave near her traps.
Use Arcane Shift sideways out of trap lines instead of blinking forward into Caitlyn's range.
Trade back right after Piltover Peacemaker, while Caitlyn has no spell to answer your poke.

why: Lucian must dash in to deal his burst, but Arcane Shift takes Ezreal out of Piercing Light's line and away from the second half of Lucian's combo. From range, Mystic Shot keeps chipping Lucian whenever he steps up to farm, and Lucian has no way to close again once his dash is spent. Ezreal won 14 of 20 pro games (70.0%) by blinking out of the one trade Lucian wants.
tips: Blink away the moment Lucian dashes toward you, then turn and poke while his dash is down.
Aim Mystic Shot through the wave edge when Lucian steps up for a last-hit.
Avoid standing in a straight line behind minions where Piercing Light hits both you and the wave.

why: Lucian dashes in for a fast burst, but Xayah drops feathers on her way back and Bladecaller roots him if he keeps chasing through them. Featherstorm also makes Xayah untargetable through The Culling or a support engage, wasting Lucian's main kill window. Xayah won 12 of 19 pro games (63.2%) by punishing Lucian's forward dash instead of trading into it.
tips: Place feathers behind Lucian as he dashes in, then recall them with Bladecaller when he chases.
Save Featherstorm to dodge a hard engage or Lucian's ultimate, not to start fights.
Take short trades with Double Daggers and step back before Lucian finishes his full combo.

why: Jhin sets up picks from long range, but Corki pokes back with Missile Barrage without needing to stand in Deadly Flourish range, and Valkyrie leaves the Curtain Call cone. Gatling Gun also shreds resistances in extended trades where Jhin's slow fire rate cannot keep up. Corki won 10 of 18 pro games (55.6%) by matching Jhin's range and winning trades that lasted past four shots.
tips: Poke with Missile Barrage from outside Deadly Flourish range and save Valkyrie for Curtain Call.
Use Gatling Gun before trading autos so the resistance shred boosts your full exchange.
Fire a Big One missile when Jhin steps up for his fourth shot and cannot dodge quickly.

why: Ezreal relies on Arcane Shift to escape, but Ashe's Frost Shot slows every chase and Volley keeps him tagged so the blink never fully resets the trade. Enchanted Crystal Arrow also gives Ashe a long-range stun Ezreal cannot poke against, turning one hit into a full lane all-in. Ashe won 12 of 15 pro games (80.0%) by slowing Ezreal after his blink and starting fights he cannot kite.
tips: Keep Frost Shot applied after Ezreal blinks so he cannot walk away from the trade.
Use Volley to poke and slow before committing, not after Ezreal has already escaped.
Fire Enchanted Crystal Arrow when Ezreal's Arcane Shift is down or his support is out of position.

why: Caitlyn out-ranges Yunara early, but Yunara farms with splash attacks once Cultivation of Spirit is active and clears the waves Caitlyn needs for trap pressure under tower. When Caitlyn steps up to poke, Arc of Judgment's heavy slow lets Yunara close and win the extended trade Caitlyn cannot sustain. Yunara won 11 of 14 pro games (78.6%) by clearing through the range disadvantage and punishing Caitlyn's poke steps.
tips: Stack Unleash on the wave and activate Cultivation of Spirit to clear before Caitlyn sets traps.
Slow Caitlyn with Arc of Judgment when she steps forward for a headshot poke, then trade back.
Avoid walking through trap lines to chase; reset and push the next wave instead.

why: Yunara needs time in Transcendent State to pour out splash damage, but Kalista's Martial Poise hops keep her out of a fixed firing line and Rend stacks punish Yunara for staying in range. Kalista also wins the early all-in before Yunara has stacks or items, so Yunara rarely reaches her teamfight state ahead. Kalista won 9 of 13 pro games (69.2%) by hopping around Yunara's set-up and ending trades with Rend.
tips: Hop sideways with every attack so Yunara's splash and slow cannot track you in a straight line.
Stack spears during short trades and Rend before Yunara can leave your range.
Force early all-ins while Yunara has no Unleash stacks built up.

why: Jhin and Caitlyn both play at long range, but Caitlyn's 650 range and Piltover Peacemaker let her poke and push without entering Deadly Flourish range. Yordle Snap Traps under Jhin's feet punish his slow reload, and he cannot match Caitlyn's waveclear to earn a recall first. Caitlyn won 8 of 13 pro games (61.5%) by owning range, wave, and trap ground at once.
tips: Poke Jhin with Piltover Peacemaker through the wave whenever he reloads.
Place traps on Jhin's likely reload and Curtain Call spots so he must walk around them.
Push the wave first and use your range to hit tower while Jhin farms under it.

why: Jhin wants to set up from range, but Ashe matches him with Volley poke and Frost Shot slows that stop him repositioning between shots. Enchanted Crystal Arrow is also a faster, longer stun than anything Jhin can answer, so Ashe chooses when the lane fights. Ashe won 9 of 12 pro games (75.0%) by slowing Jhin's reload steps and starting the all-in first.
tips: Tag Jhin with Volley before trading so Frost Shot keeps him in your range.
Save Enchanted Crystal Arrow for when Jhin opens Curtain Call or his support engages.
Keep attacking after Jhin's fourth shot while he reloads and cannot trade back.

why: Jhin controls lane with range and roots, but Yunara clears waves with splash attacks once her stacks are up, denying Jhin the slow push he needs for trap and grenade pressure. In longer fights Yunara's attack speed in Transcendent State far out-damages Jhin's four-shot cycle. Yunara won 6 of 10 pro games (60.0%) by pushing through Jhin's set-up and winning extended fights.
tips: Build Unleash stacks on minions before trading so your first exchange is already empowered.
Use Arc of Judgment to slow Jhin when he steps up for a fourth-shot trade.
Push waves quickly instead of standing in range waiting for Jhin's poke.

why: Varus pokes and roots from range, but Jhin matches that range with Deadly Flourish off any support mark and Curtain Call from further away than Piercing Arrow can answer. Varus also has no dash, so a Flourish root or a Curtain Call slow leaves him trading into Jhin's fourth shot. Jhin won 6 of 9 pro games (66.7%) by rooting the immobile Varus first.
tips: Root Varus with Deadly Flourish off a support mark before he charges Piercing Arrow.
Open Curtain Call from outside Varus's range and slow him for your team to close in.
Save your fourth shot for Varus himself instead of spending it on the wave during a trade.

why: Zeri wants to kite at high speed with Spark Surge, but Ashe's Frost Shot slow applies on every hit and directly cuts the movement Zeri relies on. Volley also tags Zeri through the wave, and Enchanted Crystal Arrow stops a Spark Surge chase or escape outright. Ashe won 5 of 9 pro games (55.6%) by slowing Zeri below the speed her kit needs.
tips: Keep Frost Shot on Zeri at all times so Spark Surge cannot create distance.
Use Volley first in trades to slow Zeri before she starts kiting away.
Hold Enchanted Crystal Arrow for Zeri's Spark Surge dash or a chase your team can follow.

why: Yunara deals her best damage standing still in Transcendent State, but Ezreal pokes her from outside that range and Arcane Shift leaves the moment she slows him with Arc of Judgment. Ezreal also farms safely while Yunara builds stacks, so she cannot force the long trade she wants. Ezreal won 5 of 9 pro games (55.6%) by poking Yunara down before she could set up.
tips: Poke with Mystic Shot from max range while Yunara is stacking on the wave.
Save Arcane Shift for Arc of Judgment's slow or a support engage, not for farm.
Avoid trading autos inside Yunara's Transcendent State; wait it out and poke again after.

why: Caitlyn out-ranges Lucian, but only while she can keep him at arm's length; Lucian's Relentless Pursuit closes that gap in one dash and his double-shot burst lands before Caitlyn's traps matter. Once Lucian is inside her range, Caitlyn's slow attacks lose the trade and 90 Caliber Net rarely creates enough distance. Lucian won 5 of 9 pro games (55.6%) by dashing past Caitlyn's range advantage.
tips: Dash in right after Caitlyn uses Piltover Peacemaker so she cannot answer your burst.
Trade with your double shot immediately after dashing, then walk away before traps arm.
Do not dash through a placed trap line; go around it or wait for Caitlyn to step forward.

why: Ezreal blinks away from most poke lanes, but Varus's Piercing Arrow out-ranges Mystic Shot and Chain of Corruption roots Ezreal before or after the blink if it lands first. Varus also pushes faster with Hail of Arrows, forcing Ezreal to farm under tower. Varus won 5 of 9 pro games (55.6%) in this older-meta pairing by rooting Ezreal and owning the push.
tips: Charge Piercing Arrow from fog or behind the wave so Ezreal cannot blink on reaction.
Use Chain of Corruption when Arcane Shift is down or to stop Ezreal escaping a gank.
Push with Hail of Arrows and poke Ezreal while he last-hits under tower.

why: Yunara needs to stand and attack to stack and spend Unleash, but Ashe's Frost Shot slows her approach and Volley pokes her before she reaches range. Enchanted Crystal Arrow also interrupts Yunara's set-up from long range, wasting her Transcendent State window. Ashe won 7 of 8 pro games (87.5%) by keeping Yunara slowed and never letting her fire freely.
tips: Slow Yunara with Volley as she walks up to stack, then kite backwards while attacking.
Save Enchanted Crystal Arrow to stop Yunara's Transcendent State or a support engage.
Keep your distance after Yunara activates her ultimate and re-engage once it expires.

why: Jhin is immobile between shots and must stand still for Curtain Call, but Kalista hops with every attack and Rend stacks while Jhin reloads. She also dodges Deadly Flourish by hopping sideways, so Jhin's root rarely starts the pick he needs. Kalista won 6 of 8 pro games (75.0%) by hopping through Jhin's slow shot cycle and executing with Rend.
tips: Hop sideways after every attack to dodge Deadly Flourish and Jhin's fourth shot.
Stack spears while Jhin reloads, then Rend before he can walk out of range.
Force trades early before Jhin has items to burst you between hops.

why: Kalista hops into Rend range, but Xayah leaves feathers behind her as she kites and Bladecaller roots Kalista mid-hop if three feathers pass through. Featherstorm also dodges the Rend execute moment and Fate's Call engage. Xayah won 6 of 7 pro games (85.7%) by rooting Kalista's chase and going untargetable at the execute.
tips: Drop feathers behind you as Kalista hops forward, then recall them for the root.
Save Featherstorm to dodge Rend burst or a Fate's Call engage.
Avoid hopping distance trades without feathers placed; Kalista wins a plain auto-attack race.

why: Yunara must walk into auto-attack range and stand still to deal damage, but Ziggs pokes her with Bouncing Bomb from well outside that range and Satchel Charge knocks her or himself apart when she commits. Mega Inferno Bomb also clears the wave she needs for stacks from across the lane. Ziggs won 5 of 7 pro games (71.4%) by never letting Yunara reach firing range healthy.
tips: Poke Yunara with Bouncing Bomb whenever she steps up to build stacks on the wave.
Place Satchel Charge between you and Yunara and detonate it when she or her support commits.
Clear waves from max range instead of walking up to trade autos with Yunara.

why: Ezreal pokes and blinks, but Ziggs clears waves faster with Bouncing Bomb and Hexplosive Minefield, so Ezreal cannot freeze or poke from a pushed wave. Satchel Charge also destroys towers quickly after one won trade, turning Ziggs's range into structures Ezreal cannot defend alone. Ziggs won 4 of 7 pro games (57.1%) by out-clearing Ezreal and taking towers first.
tips: Clear each wave with Bouncing Bomb before Ezreal can set up a freeze.
Use Satchel Charge to execute low towers after forcing Ezreal to recall.
Poke from behind your wave so Mystic Shot cannot hit you while you throw bombs.

why: Ziggs pokes from long range, but Kai'Sa can mark him with Void Seeker and dive past the minefield with Killer Instinct once he is low or his Satchel Charge is spent. Ziggs has no reliable escape after Satchel, so one dive usually kills him before his poke matters again. Kai'Sa won 4 of 7 pro games (57.1%) in this older-meta pairing by diving Ziggs after his only knockback was used.
tips: Mark Ziggs with Void Seeker and dive only after he has used Satchel Charge.
Use Killer Instinct to land beside Ziggs, not in the middle of his minefield.
Farm safely early and avoid trading autos into Bouncing Bomb poke before your first item.

why: Lucian's burst needs him inside Jhin's range, where a Deadly Flourish root off any mark and Jhin's fourth shot out-trade his dash-in. Curtain Call also slows Lucian from far beyond his dash, so he cannot choose his engage moment. Jhin won all 6 pro games (100.0%) in this older-meta pairing, though the sample is very small.
tips: Root Lucian with Deadly Flourish when he dashes in, then land your fourth shot before he retreats.
Open Curtain Call when Lucian's dash is down and he cannot close or escape quickly.
Stand behind minions so Piercing Light cannot hit you through the wave for free.

why: Sivir clears waves instantly and Spell Shields engage, but Corki pokes her through the wave with Missile Barrage that Spell Shield cannot profitably block every time, and Gatling Gun shreds her in longer trades. Corki also matches Sivir's push once he has mana to fire rockets freely. Corki won 5 of 6 pro games (83.3%) in this older-meta pairing by poking through Sivir's waveclear.
tips: Poke Sivir with Missile Barrage through the wave instead of trading into Ricochet.
Bait Spell Shield with Phosphorus Bomb, then commit Gatling Gun and autos while it is down.
Save Valkyrie to leave when On the Hunt starts, rather than diving into Sivir's team.

why: Ashe slows targets and starts fights with her arrow, but Kalista hops out of Volley's cone and Rend out-damages Ashe in the close trades Ashe's slow forces. Fate's Call also gives Kalista an engage or rescue Ashe cannot match with her low mobility. Kalista won 4 of 6 pro games (66.7%) by hopping through Ashe's slows and winning the all-in Ashe starts.
tips: Hop sideways out of Volley and keep attacking so Rend stacks build through Ashe's slow.
Rend early to slow Ashe if she kites away, or save it to execute after a long trade.
Use Fate's Call to engage when Enchanted Crystal Arrow is down.

why: Ziggs out-ranges most marksmen, but Ashe's Volley out-ranges his auto-attacks and Frost Shot slows him so Bouncing Bomb poke cannot be followed or escaped cleanly. Enchanted Crystal Arrow also gives Ashe a hard engage Ziggs's Satchel Charge alone cannot reliably stop. Ashe won 4 of 6 pro games (66.7%) in this older-meta pairing by slowing Ziggs and choosing the fight with her arrow.
tips: Poke Ziggs with Volley from max range before he can answer with Bouncing Bomb.
Keep Frost Shot applied so Ziggs cannot walk away after throwing his poke.
Fire Enchanted Crystal Arrow when Satchel Charge is down or Ziggs is clearing a wave.

why: Varus pokes and roots from range, but Spell Shield blocks Chain of Corruption or a charged Piercing Arrow, removing his one engage tool. Sivir then clears the wave faster than Varus and uses On the Hunt to force fights before he can poke again. Sivir won 4 of 6 pro games (66.7%) in this older-meta pairing by shielding Varus's root and out-pushing him.
tips: Save Spell Shield for Chain of Corruption instead of spending it on Piercing Arrow poke.
Clear waves with Ricochet and Boomerang Blade before Varus can charge a shot safely.
Use On the Hunt right after blocking Varus's ultimate so his team cannot reset.
